thread:
Amanda R.: quick one — after last night's 503 cascade we had a few handoff/paging gaps that made the live mitigation kinda messy. thinking we should land a tiny automation: when incident severity >= P1, auto-create a post-incident ticket + pre-fill remediation checklist and schedule a postmortem slot. observed issue: page escalation skipped level 2 for ~45m. :rotating_light:

Josh C.: ugh. do we have the pager delivery logs? timeline?

Amanda R.: timeline in short: 01:22 alert fired, incident-bot created INC-2026-0312-7 at 01:23, initial page sent to oncall-level1; pager service returned intermittent 502s, escalation to level2 didn't trigger until 02:07 when someone manually escalated. customer 3rd-party errors spike at same time.

Kevin L.: I pulled logs — looks like the pager gateway returned 502 on retries. snippet:
```
[2026-03-12T01:23:45Z] incident-bot ERROR notify.pager: 502 Bad Gateway request_id=abc123
[2026-03-12T01:24:10Z] incident-bot WARN retry.notify.pager attempt=2
```
looks like our retry policy hits circuit-breaker after 2 fails and we never queued escalation messages properly.

Lee M.: IncidentBot shows it created the incident but the escalation state machine didn't persist the scheduled escalation job. Might be race with job-worker restart.

IncidentBot: Incident INC-2026-0312-7 created by alert-service. Current state: acknowledged=false, severity=P1, assigned=oncall-level1. Escalation job scheduled id=escal-77 failed to persist.

Amanda R.: thanks. two categories of follow-up imo: immediate infra fixes (pager retries + ensure escalation jobs persist across workers) and process/tooling improvements (auto-postmortem creation, pre-filled checklist, auto-scheduling, and a single dashboard card with action items).

Josh C.: for automation, we could wire /postmortem create INC-2026-0312-7 to create a jira/ticket with templated fields and a checklist. also ping remediation-bot to create action items and cron a meeting slot based on team prefs.

Kevin L.: agree. small implementation plan:
- infra (P0): increase pager retry + fix persistence of escalation jobs (owner: Kevin)
- infra (P1): add health check on job-worker restart to rehydrate pending escalations (owner: Lee)
- tooling (P1): /postmortem endpoint + template + auto-ticket (owner: Amanda)
- ops (P2): dashboard card in Console showing outstanding postmortem actions (owner: Josh)

Amanda R.: I'm happy to own the /postmortem endpoint PoC. planned behavior: when incident created with severity >= P1 or when oncall hits "/postmortem create <INC>", it should:
1) create ticket in incubator tracker with pre-filled title, severity, timeline stub
2) attach incident timeline + key logs link
3) create RemediationsBot checklist entries and assign tentative owners based on alert tags
4) schedule a 45min postmortem slot in next 72h if possible (opt-out available)

RemediationsBot: created checklist for INC-2026-0312-7: [Triage timeline, Pager retry policy update, Escalation job persistence fix]. Items created as tasks T-459, T-460, T-461.

Josh C.: one quick UX ask — pre-populate the checklist with suggested owners from the incident tags (eg service=api -> owner=@kevinl). saves a manual step and speeds follow-up.

Kevin L.: agreed. also add a step to auto-calc customer-impact summary and populate the ticket field (eg customers-impacted=3, pages-sent=27, duration=45m). we already compute those metrics in the incident runbook.

Lee M.: for scheduling, can we integrate with team calendar preferences? maybe try 3 suggested slots, post a thread message like: "pick one" and auto-book when someone reacts with :thumbsup:?

Amanda R.: yeah that's the plan — bot posts 3 slots, first :thumbsup: locks it. fallback to manual if none chosen after 48h. also include timezone math.

SRE Team: +1 on the automation but need review of permissions for the bot to book calendars and create tickets. security review required before enabling org-wide.

Amanda R.: noted — I'll draft a short RFC and run it through security. proposed milestones in RFC: PoC (no calendar writes, just ticket + checklist), security signoff, calendar integration, dashboard card.

Kevin L.: for infra fix I'll open a short PR to change retry policy and add idempotent persistence for escalations. patch ETA EOD tomorrow.

Josh C.: I'll own the dashboard card. plan: small Console widget showing "Open postmortems", "Overdue actions", and links to incidents. want it on the SRE landing page.

Amanda R.: can we also capture lessons as structured tags so Optimize can warn when model/traffic patterns correlate with incidents? separate ask but useful.

Lee M.: noted — add "incident-tags" field to the ticket template.

Amanda R.: action list quick summary:
- [Amanda] RFC + PoC for /postmortem create (ticket + checklist) — due 2026-03-18
- [Kevin] Pager retry + escalation persistence fix PR — due 2026-03-13 EOD
- [Lee] Job-worker rehydrate healthcheck — due 2026-03-20
- [Josh] Console dashboard card MVP — due 2026-03-22
- [SRE Team] Security signoff for calendar/ticket bot perms — sync requested this week

Amanda R.: scheduling postmortem: proposing Thu 2026-03-14 16:00 PT. can folks react with :thumbsup: to confirm? I'll book if we hit a +1 from the oncall rotation leads.

Kevin L.: :thumbsup: I'm in.

Josh C.: :thumbsup:

Lee M.: I'll reserve the slot but mark tentative until RFC approved. :+1:

Amanda R.: great. I'll create INC-2026-0312-7/postmortem ticket now and add initial checklist. tag me for review. thanks everyone — let's keep the fixes small and iterative so we can close the big gaps before next weekend. :wave:
